title: Extremely Dull Cheese Slicer
text:
Extremely Dull Cheese Slicer. This AMAZONCOMMERCIAL STAINLESS STEEL CHEESE SLICER was a huge disappointment. It’s very dull--too dull to use to clean mold off the outsides of blocks of cheese. (I picked up the tip about using a cheese slicer to clean up slightly moldy cheese when I attended a wine & cheese tasting event in California’s Wine Country.)

When I tested the slicer on a hardened piece of cheddar cheese (about 2” x 4”), the slicer produced extremely thin slices about 1½” long, no matter how much pressure I applied. My existing cheese slicer produced ¼” thick slices that were a full 4” long.

This is supposedly a “commercial” product. I would hate to be an employee who is expected to use this dull cheese slicer on a regular basis.

The slicer is made of stainless steel. It's dishwasher safe. It has a comfortable-to-hold handle.
